projects.name: & Administration:  Served as an administrator and project planner for CA Clarity PPM and SharePoint, ensuring
details: efficient project tracking, documentation, and resource management.
• Managed end-to-end Data Governance activities  across multiple risk domains, ensuring data ownership, stewardship,
quality, lineage, controls, review and approval requirements were tracked through closure.
• Coordinated with Data Owners, Data Stewards and Risk Stewards to validate critical data elements, governance
requirements, data-quality issues and control compliance, driving timely remediation of identified gaps.
• Governed data ownership and accountability frameworks, ensuring appropriate owners and stewards were assigned
to critical data assets, applications and risk-reporting processes.
• Performed data-quality and governance gap assessments, identifying issues related to completeness, accuracy,
consistency, ownership and metadata, and driving corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
• Managed Data Visa governance workflows, coordinating steward reviews, approvals, exceptions and remediation
activities while maintaining complete audit trails and governance documentation.
• Maintained governance trackers and MI dashboards covering data assets, stewardship status, approvals, data-quality
issues, risks, dependencies and remediation progress for senior management reporting.
• Supported data lineage and metadata governance activities, ensuring critical data flows and reporting processes had
appropriate ownership, documentation and traceability.
• Partnered with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Business and Operations teams to embed data governance controls
into project and program delivery and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.
• Executive Reporting & Governance:  Led the preparation of complex top management reports, including governance decks,
dashboards, data analysis, and risk assessments to guide strategic decision-making.
• Process Automation & Efficiency:  Spearheaded process automation initiatives, reducing project timelines by 65% and enhancing
overall operational efficiency.
• Coordinated with Data Owners and Risk Stewards  across multiple risk domains to validate data governance
requirements, resolve data-quality gaps, and obtain timely reviews and approvals.

• Drove end-to-end governance tracking and escalation, maintaining RAID and Data Visa trackers, monitoring critical- path activities, escalating overdue actions, and ensuring timely closure of risks, issues, and dependencies
• PMO & Ad Hoc Reporting:  Played a key role in the PMO function for infrastructure management, developing and delivering ad hoc
reports to meet business needs.
• Process Migration & Optimization:  Successfully migrated reporting processes across teams, implementing automation solutions
that eliminated 85% of manual Excel-based tasks using VBA macros.
• MIS Process Integration:  Led the migration of MIS processes from the UK and US to Capgemini India, streamlining reporting
workflows and improving data accuracy.
